projects.name: OpenAirTwin
projects.tagline: An open-source 3D digital twin platform for wireless communication, sensing, and AI research.
projects.description: OpenAirTwin is an open-source 3D digital twin platform for physics-based wireless communication, sensing, and AI research. Built on Sionna RT 2.2.0, Three.js, and a React web workstation, it pairs real-world 3D city geometry with GPU- and CPU-accelerated ray tracing for propagation analysis, mobility, coverage mapping, DeepMIMO dataset generation, and OFDM radar sensing.
projects.image_alt: OpenAirTwin workbench interface showing a three-dimensional Hong Kong city scene, multipath propagation rays, and wireless analysis controls

features.title: 3D City Digital Twin
features.description: Load real-world 3D urban tiles on demand, including buildings, terrain, infrastructure, and vegetation, for site-specific ray tracing.

features.title: Link Analysis
features.description: Compute 3D multipath propagation between configurable Tx/Rx antenna arrays, and inspect ray geometry, received power, CIR, and power delay profiles.

features.title: Mobility Simulation
features.description: Evaluate time-varying multipath channels along 3D trajectories with synchronized per-step metrics and interactive path playback.

features.title: Radio Map
features.description: Generate terrain-following coverage and path-gain heatmaps across dense urban scenes for blockage and deployment analysis.

features.title: DeepMIMO Dataset Export
features.description: Export site-specific, ray-traced channel datasets over custom 3D regions of interest in standard DeepMIMO format for wireless AI research.

features.title: OFDM Radar Sensing
features.description: Simulate monostatic and bistatic urban radar with moving 3D UAV targets, physical RCS and clutter modeling, range–Doppler processing, and CA-CFAR detection.

projects.citation: Wang, Z., Zhou, Z., & Zhao, Z. (2026). OpenAirTwin (Version 1.2.0) [Computer software]. https://github.com/HKUOpenSource/OpenAirTwin/releases/tag/v1.2.0
